notes.title: Thank you all for playing the demo!
notes.notes:
A Huge Thank You from the Moon Mind Studio Team!

To all the plumbers out there who played the Just Plumbers in Hallowville demo and took the time to share your feedback: THANK YOU! 🚰✨

Your insights and suggestions have been instrumental in shaping the game into a better, more chaotic, and funnier experience. We’ve been hard at work implementing improvements based on your ideas, and we’re excited to show you what’s coming next!

Stay tuned for more updates!

Follow us on Twiter: https://twitter.com/MoonMindStudio

See you in Hallowville,
The Moon Mind Studio Team

notes.title: Free demo available now!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce the release of our [b]free demo, for a limited time only![/b] Explore the twisted corridors of Hallowville and test your skills as you connect pipes and tackle challenging tasks. Take control of two unlikely plumbers as they race against the clock to fix pipes and survive encounters with eerie clients.

Download the demo now and get ready for a spine-chilling adventure in Just Plumbers! Don't miss this opportunity to uncover the mysteries of Hallowville. Be prepared to dive into the unknown... if you dare. 🔧🐙
